Overview

Nice is a city in Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur with a population of 343,000. The jewel of the French Riviera with a stunning Mediterranean coastline, Belle Époque architecture, and a glamorous promenade. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
